notes: Raw lexical scores displayed. Heatmap colors use per-dataset, per-metric min-max scaling across observed values only; missing values uncolored. Baselines retain source protocols, not a common re-evaluation. No CheXpert; no Hulu-Med-14B. Same 8B checkpoint applies to VQA and report scores; feedback-subset scope is documented in paper appendix. RaTEScore-only additions transcribed from the author's 2026-09-17 screenshot; MIMIC-CXR lexical entries subsequently supplemented from the author's report_nlg_metrics_mimic.pdf/png (2026-09-17). MedSkillFlow rows excluded; CoEvoMed-8B/32B lexical values supplied by the author on 2026-09-18 are complete for both datasets, with original precision retained. Missing IU-Xray entries for GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Flash, MedGemma-27B, QoQMed-VL-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and both datasets for Claude-Sonnet-4, are filled from Hulu-Med Figure 2(a), PDF page 19. Existing non-missing scores and all RaTEScores are unchanged. Values absent from both author records and Hulu-Med remain null; no cross-version substitution. Claude-Sonnet-4.6 is retained separately from Claude-Sonnet-4 in the source record. At the author's request, GPT-5.4, Claude-Sonnet-4.6, Qwen3-VL-8B (zero-shot), and Qwen3-VL-32B (base) are excluded from the appendix lexical heatmap; source scores and main-text RaTEScore visibility are unchanged. Updated from author-supplied 2D_result/other_model.json on 2026-09-17: five new models; refreshed GMAI-VL and replaced the legacy Qwen3-VL-8B (base) report row with the explicitly labeled zero-shot result. Raw source preserved; normalized source and validation issues stored in draft_support/other_model_2d_*.json. Claude-Sonnet-4 and Claude-Sonnet-4.6 are excluded from main-text comparisons at the author's request; raw scores are retained.
latest_qwen32_update: 2026-09-18: Qwen3-VL-32B now denotes Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct from the author's complete evaluation. Both report datasets replace legacy values, and the model is restored to the lexical heatmap. This supersedes the earlier exclusion and values described in the historical notes.
